name: Editorial Story Deck
description: A manual story carousel pairing original geometric studies with editorial copy and large figures, with clear controls and no autoplay.

props.name: slides
props.description: Unique IDs, headings, copy, figures and orbit/grid/steps artwork variants.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial slide. Finite values are floored and clamped to the available range; non-finite values select the first slide.

props.name: onSlideChange
props.description: Zero-based active slide after explicit navigation.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
